Tage Thompson has ten goals in 16 games and five of them came in two nights in California, a hat trick in Anaheim and two more in Los Angeles to cap a 3-0 trip. Buffalo Hockey Beat writes that a position change has him "dominant" and eyeing 50 goals, and our numbers like the pace: his goals have added 2.14 wins this season, fourth of 499 skaters.

The volume is the convincing part. He has 68 shots on goal, his shooting rate (14.7 percent) is right on last season's, and Corey Sznajder's All Three Zones tracking had him in the 93rd percentile among forwards for chances from in front of the net. At 6'6", he is hard to move from there.

The worry sits around him. The Sabres have scored 8.2 more goals than their chances deserve with him on the ice, and their five-on-five chance share with him out there is 47.4 percent. Some of his assists will dry up. Our projection still lands around 43 goals over a full season. If the line around him starts winning the shot battle, 50 is in play.
headline: Thompson is heating up, and the Sabres with him
